title: Ice Meez Shares A New Released Single, "Fake Friends"
htmlContent:
Northern California-based artist Ice Meez delivers a brand new single, "Fake Friends," which paints a clear vision of negotiating with fake people.

His latest track, "Fake Friends," displays a relatable music idea that we all have encountered at some point in our lives.  Ice Meez is an artist with over ten years of field performance. With prominent artists like Sage the Gemini, E40, San Quinn, and Dubee, along with countless others from his region. Since the release of his debut track “Fake Friends,” which has garnered streams as his fanbase continues to grow.

Stream Ice Meez’s “Fake Friends” on Spotify.
